title: Step 4 — Replication audit and repair
body:
# Step 4 — Replication audit and repair

Keep Steps 1–3 working and implement `blobstore.replicas`. A `ReplicaSet`
replicates verified objects, audits healthy/missing/corrupt states
deterministically, quarantines corrupt destination files, and repairs only from
a healthy source. Repair must verify the destination and must not mutate the
primary or an already healthy replica.
